name: Kenco / The Shippers Group - Wilmer TX

fieldNotes.site: 500 S Millers Ferry Rd is the Whirlpool Regional Distribution Center - a ~1,020,000 SF building on ~57 acres. The Shippers Group / Kenco operates the Whirlpool finished-goods warehouse here (~822,000 SF dedicated space cited for the Kenco-Wilmer operation).
fieldNotes.truckGate: The dock yard is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence. 2026-02 Street View shows a wide gated opening (sliding chain-link gate) at the north-end truck entrance off S Millers Ferry Road; the dock yards on the N and S faces are inside the fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No dedicated 1-3-car guard booth is visible at the truck gate in available imagery. The white cylindrical structure at the SW corner is a water tank, not a gatehouse. Classified false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True - controlled truck gate but no identifiable guard booth (kiosk / app / call-box check-in likely).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large 1M+ SF building with long dock banks on both the north and south faces, trailers backed in; well into the 50+ band (estimated ~110 doors).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking drop stalls on both the north and south truck courts hold 50+ unhitched trailers.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters on opposite (north and south) building faces, consistent with split shipping vs receiving flows.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single very large warehouse on its own parcel; the other warehouses along S Millers Ferry Road are separate properties - multipleFacilities false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters this property; a rail corridor runs through the broader Wilmer logistics district but does not serve this building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Wilmer is a small town SE of Dallas off I-45; the site sits in an edge-of-town logistics district bordered by farmland - classified Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Published figure is ~57 acres; the perimeter box yields ~60 - consistent within estimate tolerance.
